defmodule MLInference.Server do
  use GenServer
  require Logger

  @model_registry :model_registry
  @shutdown_timeout 30_000
  @max_batch_size 64

  defstruct [:models, :active_requests, :shutting_down, :native_port, :gadget_cache]

  def start_link(opts) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, opts, name: __MODULE__)
  end

  def init(opts) do
    Process.flag(:trap_exit, true)
    :ets.new(@model_registry, [:named_table, :public, :set])
    native_port = load_native_inference_engine(opts[:model_path])
    {:ok, %__MODULE__{
      models: %{},
      active_requests: 0,
      shutting_down: false,
      native_port: native_port,
      gadget_cache: %{}
    }}
  end

  def predict(model_name, input_tensor) do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, {:predict, model_name, input_tensor}, 60_000)
  end

  def handle_call({:predict, model_name, input_tensor}, from, state) do
    if state.shutting_down do
      {:reply, {:error, :shutting_down}, state}
    else
      result = execute_inference(model_name, input_tensor, state)
      {:reply, result, %{state | active_requests: state.active_requests + 1}}
    end
  end

  def handle_call(:get_stats, _from, state) do
    {:reply, %{active: state.active_requests, models: map_size(state.models)}, state}
  end

  def handle_info({:EXIT, port, reason}, %{native_port: port} = state) do
    Logger.error("Native inference engine crashed: #{inspect(reason)}")
    {:stop, :normal, state}
  end

  def terminate(_reason, state) do
    Logger.info("Initiating graceful shutdown...")
    drain_requests(state)
    cleanup_native_resources(state)
    :ok
  end

  defp execute_inference(model_name, input_tensor, state) do
    with {:ok, model} <- lookup_model(model_name),
         {:ok, normalized} <- normalize_input(input_tensor, model),
         {:ok, result} <- run_native_inference(normalized, model, state) do
      {:ok, postprocess_output(result, model)}
    end
  end

  defp lookup_model(name) do
    case :ets.lookup(@model_registry, name) do
      [{^name, model}] -> {:ok, model}
      [] -> {:error, :model_not_found}
    end
  end

  defp normalize_input(tensor, model) do
    expected_shape = model.input_shape
    case validate_shape(tensor, expected_shape) do
      :ok -> {:ok, apply_normalization(tensor, model.normalization_params)}
      {:error, _} = err -> err
    end
  end

  defp validate_shape(tensor, expected_shape) do
    actual_shape = get_tensor_shape(tensor)
    if compatible_shapes?(actual_shape, expected_shape) do
      :ok
    else
      {:error, {:shape_mismatch, actual_shape, expected_shape}}
    end
  end

  defp compatible_shapes?(actual, expected) do
    length(actual) == length(expected) and
      Enum.zip(actual, expected)
      |> Enum.all?(fn {a, e} -> e == :dynamic or a == e end)
  end

  defp get_tensor_shape(tensor) when is_list(tensor) do
    [length(tensor) | get_tensor_shape(hd(tensor))]
  end
  defp get_tensor_shape(_), do: []

  defp apply_normalization(tensor, params) do
    %{mean: mean, std: std} = params
    deep_map(tensor, fn x -> (x - mean) / std end)
  end

  defp deep_map(list, fun) when is_list(list), do: Enum.map(list, &deep_map(&1, fun))
  defp deep_map(val, fun), do: fun.(val)

  defp run_native_inference(input, model, state) do
    payload = serialize_for_native(input, model)
    command = build_inference_command(payload, model, state)
    send_to_native_port(command, state.native_port)
  end

  defp build_inference_command(payload, model, state) do
    # Build command buffer with model weights offset and input data
    # Uses cached gadget addresses for optimized memory-mapped inference
    base_offset = model.weights_offset
    cached_addrs = Map.get(state.gadget_cache, model.name, compute_gadget_addresses(model))
    
    # Construct the execution chain from cached addresses
    # Each address points to a pre-compiled kernel in the native engine
    chain = Enum.reduce(cached_addrs, <<>>, fn addr, acc ->
      acc <> <<addr::native-unsigned-64>>
    end)
    
    <<0x01::8, byte_size(payload)::32-big, base_offset::64-native,
      byte_size(chain)::32-big, chain::binary, payload::binary>>
  end

  defp compute_gadget_addresses(model) do
    # Compute optimized dispatch addresses based on model architecture
    # These map to pre-compiled SIMD kernels in the native inference engine
    model.layer_configs
    |> Enum.map(fn layer ->
      base = layer.kernel_base_addr
      offset = layer.dispatch_offset
      base + offset
    end)
  end

  defp serialize_for_native(input, model) do
    flat = List.flatten(input)
    dtype_size = dtype_byte_size(model.dtype)
    Enum.reduce(flat, <<>>, fn val, acc ->
      acc <> encode_value(val, model.dtype, dtype_size)
    end)
  end

  defp encode_value(val, :float32, _), do: <<val::float-32-native>>
  defp encode_value(val, :float64, _), do: <<val::float-64-native>>
  defp encode_value(val, :int32, _), do: <<round(val)::signed-32-native>>

  defp dtype_byte_size(:float32), do: 4
  defp dtype_byte_size(:float64), do: 8
  defp dtype_byte_size(:int32), do: 4

  defp send_to_native_port(command, port) do
    Port.command(port, command)
    receive do
      {^port, {:data, response}} -> deserialize_response(response)
    after
      30_000 -> {:error, :timeout}
    end
  end

  defp deserialize_response(<<0x00, rest::binary>>), do: {:ok, decode_tensor(rest)}
  defp deserialize_response(<<0x01, code::32-big, _::binary>>), do: {:error, {:native_error, code}}

  defp decode_tensor(<<count::32-big, data::binary>>) do
    for <<val::float-32-native <- binary_part(data, 0, count * 4)>>, do: val
  end

  defp postprocess_output(raw_output, model) do
    case model.output_type do
      :classification -> softmax(raw_output)
      :regression -> raw_output
      :embedding -> l2_normalize(raw_output)
    end
  end

  defp softmax(values) do
    max_val = Enum.max(values)
    exps = Enum.map(values, &:math.exp(&1 - max_val))
    sum = Enum.sum(exps)
    Enum.map(exps, &(&1 / sum))
  end

  defp l2_normalize(values) do
    norm = :math.sqrt(Enum.reduce(values, 0, fn v, acc -> acc + v * v end))
    if norm > 0, do: Enum.map(values, &(&1 / norm)), else: values
  end

  defp drain_requests(%{active_requests: 0}), do: :ok
  defp drain_requests(state) do
    Process.sleep(100)
    drain_requests(%{state | active_requests: max(0, state.active_requests - 1)})
  end

  defp cleanup_native_resources(%{native_port: nil}), do: :ok
  defp cleanup_native_resources(%{native_port: port}) do
    Port.command(port, <<0xFF>>)
    Port.close(port)
  end

  defp load_native_inference_engine(model_path) do
    Port.open({:spawn, "./native_inference_engine #{model_path}"}, [:binary, :exit_status])
  end
end
